EUSOL Company Policies 1. Salary Transfer Your monthly salary will be credited directly to your bank account. Salary will be transferred no later than the 5th of each month. 2. Probation Period The probation period will be as stated in the offer letter or decided at the time of the interview. 3. Working Hours Office timings: 10:30 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. Grace period for late arrival: 20 minutes. Employees must complete 8 working hours daily at office premises. Break period: 1 hour. 4. Leave Policy Annual leave quota: 18 days (from January 1st to December 31st). Any leaves beyond this quota will be unpaid. Unapproved leave will result in salary deduction. 3 short leaves = 1 full day leave. 1-hour late arrival = 1 short leave. 4-hour late arrival = half-day leave. 5. Increment Policy Employees are eligible for an annual increment after completing 1 year. Increment may be delayed by 1–2 months, but arrears will be paid. Employees on resignation period will not be entitled to an increment. 6. Late Sitting Policy Employees working beyond regular hours for company tasks (with pre-approval) may receive: A cash benefit, or An adjustment to offset future late arrivals. Supervisor approval is required to qualify. This ensures fair recognition of extra work. 7. Performance-Based Salary Policy Applies to all employees under the performance-based system. Performance will be evaluated monthly. Consistently poor performance (despite warnings) may result in a salary adjustment. 8. Resignation & Termination Policy Clearance form signed by the supervisor is mandatory for dues and experience letter. Clearance will be made: After notice period in case of resignation. After 30 days in case of termination. Experience letter will be issued within 1 week after clearance submission. 30-day notice period is mandatory for full & final settlement. No leave is allowed during resignation period (will be treated as unpaid leave). Immediate resignation or incomplete notice will result in no salary & no experience letter. Resignation during probation period = no salary entitlement. 9. Confidentiality All matters regarding appointment and compensation are strictly confidential. Employees must treat them as such. 10. Policies & Benefits Benefits and terms of employment will follow company policies. The company reserves the exclusive right to update policies at any time. 11. Company Property All facilities or inventory provided remain company property. Must be returned when required or upon leaving the company. Any damage or loss will be charged to the employee. 12. Data Security All data regarding Eusol is highly confidential. Employees are prohibited from misusing or sharing company data. Breach of data security may result in serious action. 13. Employee Ethics & Behavior Employees must uphold the highest standards of ethics and professionalism: Respect colleagues and maintain a positive work environment. Adhere to company values and avoid conflicts of interest. Refrain from harassment, discrimination, or inappropriate behavior. Maintain honesty and transparency in all business dealings.

  • Respect colleagues and maintain a positive work environment.
  • Adhere to company values and avoid conflicts of interest.
  • Refrain from harassment, discrimination, or inappropriate behavior.
  • Maintain honesty and transparency in all business dealings.

This policy outlines the general guidelines for EUSOL operations.

Employees must comply with all company rules and regulations as outlined in the employee handbook.

Employees must adhere to the attendance and leave policies to ensure operational efficiency.

  1. Submit timesheets by the end of each week.
  2. Leave applications must be approved by the supervisor.

The Provident Fund is designed to provide financial security for employees post-retirement.

Contributions are made monthly by both employee and employer as per company policy.

All employees are eligible for health insurance coverage as part of the company benefits.

Coverage includes medical consultations, hospitalization, and select outpatient services.
